fact: On 8 November 2023 the Council of Ministers adopted a decree for an integrated human resources system for the state and local civil services that integrates the biometric data of the RAVEC, to bring civil service payroll data into line with the RAVEC.
title: Fonctions publiques de l'Etat et des Collectivités territoriales : Mise en oeuvre de l'opération d'identification des agents !
